a.lede: Muse is topping the app store charts and adding users at a rapid clip, while Meta ramps up the personal AI agent's promotion across its own apps and beyond.
a.title: Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off

b.lede: Meta’s new AI agent Muse has racked up more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada than ChatGPT did over the same period after its mobile debut, according to new estimates from Appfigures.
b.title: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
